details.label: Alert detail
details.text:
A combination of clearing skies and light winds has resulted in
patchy dense fog developing across the area, especially the river
valleys. Some locations are seeing visibility reduced to zero. The
patchy nature of the fog can result in the visibility dropping to
zero within a short distance. Use caution if out traveling this
morning.
